Privacy policy

Effective October 27, 2026. This policy covers the PinkRyno Studios website and our games played in the web browser on this site. We will update it before any of our games launch as apps.

The short version

PinkRyno Studios does not collect personal data. Our games and this website have no ads, no tracking, and no third-party advertising, analytics, or social SDKs.

Who we are

PinkRyno Studios is an independent game studio in Florida, USA.

The contact for privacy questions is support@pinkrynostudios.com (leaves this website, a grown-up answers first).

What this policy covers

It covers pinkrynostudios.com and the games we host on it for children.

Information we collect

We do not collect personal information through the website or our games. Personal information means information that identifies a person or can reasonably be linked to a person. That includes a name, email address, phone number, photo, voice, precise location, contacts, and an account identifier.

There are no accounts, no sign-up forms, and no profile to fill in. We do not ask a child for any of those things. We do not collect gameplay analytics.

Ads, tracking, and SDKs

We do not show ads. We do not let anyone else show ads in our games or on this website. We do not use interest-based advertising.

We do not use third-party advertising SDKs, analytics SDKs, attribution SDKs, crash-reporting SDKs, or social SDKs. The website does not load fonts, pictures, or scripts from any other site.

Purchases

There is nothing to buy on this website, and the games here are free to play. We do not collect payment information.

Cookies and device storage

This website does not set cookies. The game saves progress (stars, progress, and settings) on your device, in the browser's storage. That progress is not sent to us or to anyone else, and there are no accounts, ads, or trackers. Clearing this site's data in your browser erases it. The parental gate does not save its answer.

Children

Our games and this website are directed to children under 13, and parents use them too. We follow the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act by not collecting personal information from children. Because we do not collect it, we do not ask for verifiable parental consent to collect it.

We do not knowingly receive personal information from a child. If you believe we have, email us and we will delete it.

Email you send us

If you email support@pinkrynostudios.com (leaves this website, a grown-up answers first), we receive whatever you choose to write, and we use it only to reply. Please do not include a child's name, photo, or precise location. We do not add your address to a mailing list. You can ask us to delete the conversation and we will.

How to delete information

We do not have a player profile to delete. To erase a game's saved progress, clear this site's data in your browser. To delete emails you sent us, write to support@pinkrynostudios.com (leaves this website, a grown-up answers first) and ask.

Hosting

These pages are static files. We do not add analytics, and we do not receive a report of who visited or what a child played.

The company that hosts the files may keep ordinary technical logs, such as an IP address and the page that was requested, to keep the service secure. We do not use those logs to identify a child, build a profile, or advertise, and we do not combine them with other information.

Changes

If we change this policy, we will update the date at the top of the page.

Contact

Privacy questions and support go to the same place: support@pinkrynostudios.com (leaves this website, a grown-up answers first). The support page answers common questions.
